name: 30511-hicachedecode-qwen3-8b-4gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B. Ungated, ~16 GB of bf16 weights, already in the local HF cache.
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, dense: 36 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 12288, vocab 151936, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128 (GQA), bf16, max_position_embeddings 40960.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), 8 streams, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 320 requests with a 2700 s safety cap -- about 256 measured requests, roughly 23 minutes.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, seed 30511. 16384 prompt and 2048 output tokens as POINT values (min == max), with `ignore_eos` so every request emits all 2048. Prompts are random tokens and share no prefix.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant on four GPUs, serving eight concurrent users 16k-token prompts with 2k-token answers.
launch:
# sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id`.
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is skipped by the reader, and the engine would then
# start without something this file declares. host/port/served-model-name come from the launcher.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tp-size: 4

enable-hierarchical-cache: true
hicache-io-backend: direct
hicache-mem-layout: page_first_direct
hicache-write-policy: write_through

# GB of pinned host memory PER RANK. It must be pinned: left unset, the host pool is sized off the
# DEVICE pool by --hicache-ratio 2.0, asks for several hundred GB per rank, and either hangs or
# refuses to start. At 40 the engine logs that the host pool is smaller than the device pool; that
# warning is expected and is about prefix-reuse hit rate.
hicache-size: 40

context-length: 20480
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
